models.author: Fernando Rodrigues
models.description:
# ParteiraBR-MaternalHealth-Adapter

LoRA adapter for maternal health triage in Brazilian Portuguese — designed for communities where formal healthcare is distant: **riverine, quilombola, and backland populations** where traditional midwives are often the first point of care.

The adapter was fine-tuned on `meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct` through Adaption's **AutoScientist** platform.

Given a community health query in Brazilian Portuguese, the model:

* Classifies the symptom by urgency tier (vermelho / amarelo / verde)
* Refers to emergency services immediately for red-flag signals
* Guides users toward UBS or community health agents for yellow-flag alerts
* Provides reassurance and self-care tips for low-risk green-flag symptoms
* Never diagnoses, prescribes, or suggests home remedies for emergencies

> Submitted to the **AutoScientist Challenge 2026 — Healthcare category**.

---

## Usage

```python
from peft import PeftModel
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

BASE_MODEL = "meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct"
ADAPTER_PATH = (
    "/kaggle/input/parteirabr-maternalhealth-adapter/"
    "other/llama-3-3-70b-instruct-lora/1"
)

base_model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    BASE_MODEL,
    device_map="auto",
    torch_dtype="auto",
)

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(BASE_MODEL)

model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(
    base_model,
    ADAPTER_PATH,
)

prompt = """
ParteiraBR — Guia de Orientação em Saúde Materna Tradicional

Você é um assistente de acolhimento e navegação em saúde materna.
Diante de qualquer sinal de risco, encaminhe imediatamente ao serviço de saúde.

Contexto: uma gestante de uma comunidade ribeirinha no Amazonas perguntou:
Estou grávida e tive um sangramento forte agora. Estou com medo. O que eu faço?
""".strip()

inputs = tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt").to(model.device)

outputs = model.generate(
    **inputs,
    max_new_tokens=512,
    do_sample=True,
    temperature=0.7,
    top_p=0.9,
)

generated_tokens = outputs[0][inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]:]
print(tokenizer.decode(generated_tokens, skip_special_tokens=True))
```

---

## Model Statistics

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Base model | `meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct` |
| Trained model name | `adaption_llama_3_3_70b_instru_parteira_br_maternal_gui_80fa5adc` |
| Training method | Supervised Fine-Tuning with LoRA |
| Training examples | 1,200 (+ 20,000 domain-specific augmented) |
| Data format | Chat instruction/completion |

---

## Evaluation Results

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Base model win rate | 21% |
| Adapted model win rate | **80%** |
| Win rate on dataset | 57% |
| Dataset quality score | **9.0 → 10.0 (+11.1%)** |
| Dataset quality grade | **A → A** |
| Medical domain percentile | **43.9 → 57.7** |
| Safety gate pass rate | **100% — 1,200/1,200** |
| Mean rubric score | **15.41/16** |

---

## Triage Framework

| Tier | Color | Action |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 Vermelho | Emergency | Immediate referral — SAMU 192, no home guidance |
| 🟡 Amarelo | Alert | Refer to UBS within 24–48h, explain why |
| 🟢 Verde | Low risk | Reassurance + self-care tip + escalation trigger |

---

## Clinical Signals Covered (13 total)

**Vermelho:** sangramento vaginal · convulsão · dor de cabeça forte com alterações visuais · diminuição de movimentos fetais · perda de líquido amniótico antes do termo · febre alta no pós-parto com mau cheiro

**Amarelo:** inchaço súbito de rosto e mãos · ardência ao urinar · febre baixa persistente · ausência de pré-natal

**Verde:** enjoo e náusea no primeiro trimestre · cansaço e sonolência · dúvidas sobre amamentação

---

## Grounding

All 13 signals traced to specific pages in official Brazilian Ministry of Health publications:

* Caderneta Brasileira da Gestante (2026)
* Estratificação de Risco Gestacional — SES-MG (2025)
* Atenção ao Pré-Natal de Baixo Risco — CAB nº 32 (2012)
* Saúde da Criança: Aleitamento Materno — CAB nº 23 (2015)
* Manual de Gestação de Alto Risco (2022)

---

## Ethical Design

ParteiraBR enforces a strict safety gate on every completion:

* Never diagnoses any condition
* Never prescribes medication
* Never suggests home remedies for emergency symptoms
* Always refers to emergency services for red-flag signals
* Respects and values traditional midwifery knowledge

---

## Data Overview

* **Kaggle dataset:** [`fernandosr85/parteirabr-signalgrounding`](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/fernandosr85/parteirabr-signalgrounding)
* **HuggingFace dataset:** `Fernandosr85/ParteiraBR-SignalGrounding`
* **Grounding validator:** ParteiraBR v2.4

---

## Credits

| Resource | Reference |
|---|---|
| Fine-tuning platform | Adaption — AutoScientist and Adaptive Data |
| Challenge | AutoScientist Challenge 2026 — Healthcare category |
| Base model | `meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct` |
| Kaggle dataset | [`fernandosr85/parteirabr-signalgrounding`](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/fernandosr85/parteirabr-signalgrounding) |
| Author | Fernando Rodrigues |
| Kaggle | [`fernandosr85`](https://www.kaggle.com/fernandosr85) |
| HuggingFace | [`Fernandosr85`](https://huggingface.co/Fernandosr85) |

---

## Disclaimer

ParteiraBR is a research and community-health support artifact. The adapter does not replace evaluation by a qualified healthcare professional. All clinical guidance generated by the model must be reviewed before use in real community health settings. Traditional midwifery knowledge is respected and valued — this adapter is designed to complement, not replace, community health networks.

# Model Summary

Private Kaggle model asset for ARC-AGI-3 VLM serving experiments.

# Contents

This version contains a PEFT identity LoRA adapter for Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B. The adapter is initialized as a mathematical no-op and is used to verify the offline Kaggle LoRA serving path before uploading trained adapters.

# License / Attribution

Base model: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B

# Evaluation Results

No standalone evaluation is reported for this identity adapter.

PEFT LoRA adapter directory for use with vLLM `--enable-lora`.

# Model Inputs

The adapter is loaded alongside the Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B base model and served through vLLM's OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.

# Model Outputs

Because this is an identity adapter, outputs should match the base model for deterministic decoding.

# Changelog

- Initial identity LoRA upload.

instances.overview: Image-only perception LoRA adapter for the ARC-AGI-3 VLM (Qwen3.6-27B).
instances.usage:
# Model Format

PEFT LoRA adapter directory for vLLM `--enable-lora` (rank 16, alpha 32). Targets the 7 LLM projections plus the multimodal projector (merger.linear_fc1/linear_fc2), so serve with `--enable-tower-connector-lora` and `--max-lora-rank 16`.

# Model Inputs

Loaded alongside the Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B base model and served through vLLM's OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint. The agent renders the game grid at tile 8 (512x512).

# Model Outputs

Text completions for the ARC-AGI-3 agent action protocol.

# Changelog

- Initial perception finetune (1 epoch over 38.4k image-only perception examples).
